## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and related SDK issue. Explain any non-obvious design decision; update this description when scope changes.

For Blueprint-backed implementation, link the approved design revision, state the public-safe human approval scope/conditions, and include its status update or name the delivery coordinator who will record the final landed SHA after merge. The approving reviewer checks [Blueprint lifecycle records](https://github.com/MachineWisdomAI/saga-a2ui/blob/main/blueprints/README.md#lifecycle-and-revision-records).

## Validation

Record checks performed, relevant failure cases and remaining limits. Include the version-policy result and, for retained artifacts, what they prove and the verified LFS storage/upload. Follow [change hygiene](https://github.com/MachineWisdomAI/saga-a2ui/blob/main/docs/change-hygiene.md).

Keep this PR self-contained and free of private planning, customer material, credentials and sensitive security details.
